item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible evidence that Scholz used manufactured threats, nationalism, revenge, or regime-survival logic as the main justification for 2024 security decisions. The strongest borderline criticism is domestic: opposition figures argued his Taurus refusal was not fully explained and may have had political motives. That is criticism, not proof. Scholz also operated under coalition collapse and rising domestic pressure, so regime-survival incentives were present in the background, but I did not find reliable evidence that they dominated his security posture.","evidence":[{"title":"Biden and Germany's Scholz will meet in Washington as US and EU aid for Ukraine hangs in the balance","publisher":"AP","date":"27 Jan 2024","url":"https://apnews.com/article/348c86c880d7f9ac9c72d76c6638b305","summary":"The AP summary said the leaders would reaffirm support for Ukraine’s defense and discuss preventing regional escalation in the Middle East.
